content.short: Upheaval is a concentrated liquidity DEX on Hyperliquid for deploying capital across tight price ranges.
content.description: Upheaval runs concentrated liquidity markets on HyperEVM, letting providers place capital in narrow bands where most trading actually happens. A swap aggregator routes across venues on the chain, with multichain swaps available from the same interface. Its liquidity hub concentrates incentives, and the project launched a community token with no team allocation, no funds raised and no insider allocation. A second season of points is running for users trading and providing liquidity.
content.meta: Concentrated liquidity on Hyperliquid, efficient while price stays inside the chosen band.
